Name: Custom_Biped_Rotate_Orders
Description: Custom biped controller rotate order setup

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Applies biped rotate orders to existing controllers.

How To Use:
  Build this block after your rig ctrls exist.

Behavior:
- No per-part toggles.
- Applies configured rotate order where controller exists.
- Auto-applies to R_ when L_ controller is listed.
